summary: editable-contracts@0.0.12 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it, sets it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a bundled 727 KB file `math_init.js`. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are obfuscator.io-encoded (string-array dictionary with rotator and base64 decoder in math_init.js; `_0x` renamed identifiers in setup.mjs). The advertised purpose of the package is a small MobX-based form helper (main: dist/editable-contracts.js), and neither setup.mjs nor math_init.js relates to that functionality; math_init.js begins with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, confirming it is intended to be run by the downloaded Bun runtime and not by Node. Fetching a second language runtime to execute an obfuscated payload at install time is a classic alternate-runtime dropper pattern used to evade Node-based static analysis. Installing the package causes attacker-authored obfuscated code to run automatically on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
